backWardSettings.advanceXSL: <Stage-space-Users allowDuplicateValues="true"> <xsl:for-each xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" select="SourceXML/updatedFields/Property/Stage-space-Users/list"> <op_list> <stageName> <xsl:value-of select="Property/stageName"/> </stageName> <userMeta> <userName> <xsl:value-of select="Property/userMeta/Property/userName"/> </userName> <userEmail> <xsl:value-of select="Property/userMeta/Property/userEmail"/> </userEmail> <userDisplayName> <xsl:choose> <xsl:when test="Property/userMeta/Property/userEmail != ''"> <xsl:variable name="emailTarget" select="userUtils:getUserNameFromEmail( $workflowId, $targetSystemId, Property/userMeta/Property/userEmail, 'false', 'false' )"/> <xsl:choose> <xsl:when test="$emailTarget != ''"> <xsl:value-of select="$emailTarget"/> </xsl:when> <xsl:otherwise> <xsl:value-of select="Property/userMeta/Property/userDisplayName"/> </xsl:otherwise> </xsl:choose> </xsl:when> <xsl:otherwise> <xsl:value-of select="Property/userMeta/Property/userDisplayName"/> </xsl:otherwise> </xsl:choose> </userDisplayName> </userMeta> <role> <xsl:value-of select="Property/role"/> </role> </op_list> </xsl:for-each> </Stage-space-Users>
